about: Fast paced, arcade style, FPS action awaits in this World War II based shooter. Traditional FPS gameplay is joined with some elements of RTS base building to provide a unique FPS experience.
- Over forty stages spread across four distinct levels.
- Train soldiers to fight with you.
- Protect and upgrade your armory to gain access to more weapons.
- Protect and upgrade your barracks to train all soldier classes.
Enhanced play with PlayStation VR aim controller
